verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
O Lord, you are the center of my life
I will always praise you

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I will always serve you
I will always keep you in my sight

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Keep me safe, O God, I take refuge in You
I say to the Lord you are my God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My happiness lies in You alone
My happiness lies in You alone

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I will bless the Lord who gives me counsel
Who even at night directs my heart

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I keep the Lord ever in my sight
Since He is at my right hand
I shall stand firm

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
And so my heart rejoices my soul is glad
Even in safety shall my body rest

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
For you will not leave my soul among the dead
Nor let your beloved know decay

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
You will show me the path of life
The fullness of joy in Your presence

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
At Your right hand, at Your right hand
Happiness forever
